description: This source file is a shell script containing automated test cases for git push operations, including scenarios like atomic push, forced push, non-fast-forward push, and cleanup procedures. It uses shell commands, git commands, and custom test utilities to verify repository state and output formatting.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects the enclosed shell commands to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects the enclosed shell commands to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output, used to verify command results.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares git reference states between local and remote repositories.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Converts raw command output into a user-friendly, stable format for comparison.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats expected output and saves it for comparison.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters and stabilizes command output for reliable testing.
